decisions.reason: Because this pegboard-backed cardboard display stays close to the firm's core routines and customer base, management would usually retain it unless the loss of standalone visibility reflects a clear sales shortfall against aspiration levels.

This quarter-pallet cardboard display is highly aligned with the firm's main offer, so a large firm with existing slack would likely continue it as part of the core range despite weaker website evidence.

The wooden display pallet is less central to the firm's established cardboard-focused capabilities, and after several years of uncertain visibility management would likely reallocate resources to better-performing core products and new development.

Although more specialized, this media-focused quarter-pallet display still uses familiar design and production resources, so management would likely keep it unless its niche demand has persistently fallen below aspiration.
